meta.scope: Iran Batch 8 — Power generation, mining/minerals, and further provincial densification (Isfahan, Fars, Bushehr).

candidates.title: Electricity generation and installed capacity statistics
candidates.description: Installed generation capacity (thermal, combined-cycle, hydro, nuclear, renewables) and electricity production statistics. Capacity has surpassed 100 GW; gas and combined-cycle dominate; nuclear and renewables remain small shares.

candidates.title: Mining and mineral production statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Industry, Mine and Trade / SCI related
candidates.description: Production statistics for metallic and non-metallic minerals. Iran ranks among the world’s leading producers for several commodities (e.g. strontium, direct-reduced iron, gypsum, iron ore).
candidates.notes: Mining densification of the industrial cluster.

candidates.title: Isfahan province Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Isfahan — a major industrial and historic central province that ranks among the larger non-oil provincial economies.

candidates.title: Fars province Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Fars — a large southern province with mixed agriculture, services and industry that ranks in the upper tier of provincial economies.
candidates.notes: Further provincial densification in the south-central belt.

candidates.title: Bushehr province Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Bushehr — an important oil, gas and petrochemical province on the Persian Gulf that ranks among the larger provincial economies relative to its population.

candidates.title: Iran power–mining–provincial densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from energy, mining and SCI sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding electricity generation capacity and production, mining/mineral statistics, and the GRDP series for Isfahan, Fars and Bushehr into a coherent energy–mining–further-provincial layer.
